test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **acces**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling and meaning of the selected option are as follows: • **Access: **the chance or right to use or have something. (किसी वस्‍तु को प्रयोग में लाने या प्राप्‍त करने का अवसर या अधिकार) • Thus, the incorrectly spelt word is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Adopt: **to take and use something. (किसी विधि को अपनाना) • **Abandon: **to leave somebody/something that you are responsible for, usually permanently. (किसी प्राणी या वस्‍तु को, जिस का उत्तरदायित्‍व आप पर है, प्रायः सदा के लिए छोड़ देना) • **Abase: **behave in a way that belittles or degrades (someone). (अपमानित करना) 1bc:T8c0, The correct answer is **constellation**.
